name: Bresal Bélach

attributes.attribute: an early Irish personage of legend
a timber fortress shaped like a boat set on dry land

text: Bresal Bélach belongs to the shadowy figures of early Ireland. The old books name him the builder of Bare Bresail. That was a timber fortress shaped like a boat set upon dry land. He is said to have defeated Cairbre Lifechair at the storied battle of Cnámross. He may well have won that field with the help of Fionn mac Cumhaill standing with him.

okr.objective: Describe the early Irish figure Bresal Bélach and his deeds.
key_results: The old books name him builder of the fortress Bare Bresail.
